comment: Limits for the testing gauntlet. Plain keys are floors: raise when counts grow, never lower. Keys ending in _max are ceilings: lower when quality improves, never raise (CLAUDE.md E6). 'What counts as finished work' (CLAUDE.md) governs every change.

_retired._why: Floors whose SUBJECT left the product. A key that simply vanishes from this file cannot be told apart from a key deleted to make a build pass; a key recorded here with its last value, its date and its reason can. E6 forbids lowering a floor and this is not that: nothing these counted still exists to be counted.

g15_recognizer_tests.why: The whole G15 gate. Its subject was the browser speech recogniser contract; the child-facing microphone was removed on the owner's safety ruling of 2026-08-11, tests/recognizer.test.js was deleted, and the counter in tools/gauntlet.mjs went with it in the same commit. No surviving rule lost its guard: S1's adult-only clause became absolute and is now covered by tests/safety.test.js 1, 2, 2a and 3.
